text: Ko An yo Annabiijo! Duumor e kulol Alla -an e ɓen wonnduɓe e maaɗa- ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo e haɗaaɗi makko, hulaa Mo Kanko tun, wata a ɗofto heeferɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe ɓen e kon welata wonkiiiji maɓɓe. Pellet, Alla laatike Annduɗo ko heeferɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe ɓen fewjata kon, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun e toppitagol Mun.
